download_llama2_tokenizer: download the llama2 tokenizer model from meta-llama/Llama-2-7b to a local directory
download_llama3_tokenizer: download the llama3 tokenizer model from meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B to a local directory
download_gemma_tokenizer: download the gemma tokenizer model from google/gemma-2-9b to a local directory
download_tiktoken_encoding: download a tiktoken encoding by name and cache it to a specified directory
run_download_tokenizer_cli: run the CLI to download a tokenizer by name to a directory with an optional API key
